verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a note-taking app, but nothing in the evidence shows Obsidian ships a first-party AI that answers, summarizes, or drafts from your notes, or any controls over what data it sees. The only AI mention is community commentary about third-party plugins such as Text-Generator, which reportedly lack decent RAG. Third-party plugins do not count as built-in capability, so they earn no credit.
